English (current): Track your damage, live DPS, maximum DPS and damage sources in a Minecraft-style overlay. Customize the window and keybinds below. Work in progress; more features are coming.
Simplified Chinese: 以 Minecraft 风格浮窗实时显示伤害、当前 DPS、最高 DPS 与伤害来源。可在下方自定义窗口与快捷键。本模组仍在开发中，更多功能敬请期待。

English (current): 0% is left, 100% is right. Keeps the window inside the screen.
Simplified Chinese: 0% 为最左，100% 为最右。窗口始终保持在屏幕内。

English (current): Scale the damage window and its text.
Simplified Chinese: 缩放伤害窗口及其文字。

English (current): Only changes the dark panel background.
Simplified Chinese: 仅改变深色底板的背景。

English (current): Changes the entire window, including bars and text.
Simplified Chinese: 改变整个窗口，包括条状图与文字。

notes: Settings: Toggle 'Reset on area changes' Label

English (current): Live modes return to zero when you stop attacking. Average includes idle time since the first hit of this reset.
Simplified Chinese: 实时模式在停止攻击后归零；平均值包含本轮首次命中以来的空闲时间。
自首次命中起的平均值
notes: Settings: Select option 'Average since first hit'

English (current): Choose a primary key and an optional secondary key.
Simplified Chinese: 选择一个主按键，并可选择一个副按键。
notes: Settings: Keybind Description (shared by both keybinds)
Settings: Keybind 'Reset damage and maximum DPS' Label

English (current): Settings are saved automatically. Maximum DPS is the highest live DPS since the last damage reset.
Simplified Chinese: 设置会自动保存。最高 DPS 是上次重置伤害以来的实时 DPS 峰值。
